notes.title: Windows Beta v0.13
notes.content:
WindowsBetav0.13

- started to implement sub surface scattering
- added a button for windowed/fullscreen switching
- caped fps at 60, later on I will add graphic settings for fine tuning"
- added ""Would you like to quit?"" question before game quits.
- removed the fixed 3 save game slots, now you have to give them all a unique name ad save by that
- added a delete save button and confirmation window.
- windowed mode now sets the resolution to half of your desktop resolution than you can scale it from there to your liking and the default setting is windowed
- added HQ Reflections toggle to the Environments settings for optimization purposes, especially for mobile build
- HQ Planar reflections are disabled on Android as default and enabled on Windows
